resolvedVia.description: RFC 0259 — true only if the host records `interrupt.resolved.resolvedVia` on every token resolution (run-event-payloads.schema.json $defs/interruptResolved.resolvedVia), and carries `boundTo` or refuses a token resolution of an interrupt that declares eligibility.

callbackDelivery.description: RFC 0196 §A.1 — true only if the host delivers to createRun.callbackUrl (interrupt.md §Callback delivery). A host advertising it MUST hold callbackUrl to the webhooks.md §Egress guard at create time and at delivery.
